events.title: LUCC Sunday Halton 01/11/2026
events.description: Sunday Halton Session – Beginners Join us for our Sunday Morning paddling session at Halton! This session is aimed at any members who want to get onto moving water, learn some river skills, and build confidence outside of the pool (You must have completed a swim test and deck test) . Whether you're taking your first steps into whitewater or just want to get some more experience on the river, it's a great opportunity to get involved and paddle with the club. 📅 Plan for the session We'll meet at 10:00 to get organised, sort out kit and arrange transport before heading to Halton. We'll spend the afternoon paddling on the river, practising skills and getting comfortable on moving water. The session will be adapted to the group's experience and the river conditions. 🎒 Please bring Swimwear A thermal layer to wear under your wetsuit — synthetic material only, no cotton Shoes that can get wet — old trainers are ideal. No Crocs or flip-flops! Spare clothes and a towel — bring warm clothes! Food and drink, especially if you haven't eaten since lunch. 🚗 Transport We'll organise lifts to Halton. Car groups and lift allocations will be released nearer the time, so keep an eye out for updates. ⚠️ Cancellations Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you can no longer attend. Otherwise, you may still be required to contribute towards the fuel cost for the car you were assigned to. See you on the water! 🛶

We invite you to come along to our Careers Workshop with

events.title: Surgical Skills 101 - Suturing - Session 2
events.description: Surgical Skills 101: The Basics of Suturing and OR Conduct - Session 2 Join the Richard Owen Society for our second session as part of the Surgical Skills 101 series. This will be a two-hour, hands-on introduction to operating theatre etiquette and suturing (simple, continuous and mattress sutures) We'll start with the basics of the OR: sterile zones, scrubbing, who's who in the theatre team, and how medical students are expected to conduct themselves. Then you'll learn and practise different suturing techniques. Each technique begins with a short demonstration, then supervised practice with facilitators and a consultant on hand to give feedback and correct common errors. We'll finish by comparing the two techniques and discussing suture choice and wound types. By the end of the session, you'll be able to: Show correct OR etiquette and identify team roles Choose suitable suture and needle types for basic closures Perform interrupted, continuous and mattress sutures on synthetic models Explain wound tension principles and the reasoning behind suture selection.

events.title: Lancaster Sail Week 2027
events.description: LUSC x ARMADA WEEK GREECE ⛵☀️ Get ready for a week of sun, sailing, island hopping and unforgettable nights as Lancaster University Sailing Club heads to Greece for Armada Week ! We’ll be setting sail from Athens and spending the week exploring the Greek islands as part of a huge flotilla of yachts. Expect crystal-clear water, secluded swimming spots, beautiful harbours and plenty of time to relax in the sun during the day, followed by organised events, bars and parties in a different destination each night. Across the week, we’ll sail between destinations including Agia Marina, Perdika, Ermioni, Dokos and Poros , stopping off at coves and anchorages along the way. There’ll be everything from beach activities and sunset drinks to raft parties, fancy dress and big nights out — all alongside other crews taking part in Armada Week. You don’t need to be an experienced sailor to come along. Each yacht has a skipper responsible for getting the boat safely between destinations, so this is as much a summer holiday and social as it is a sailing trip. Whether you’re coming for the sailing, Greek sunshine, swimming, nightlife, or just a ridiculous week away with LUSC, this is set to be one of the highlights of the year. Think Greek islands + yacht week ⛵🍻 More details on dates, travel, prices and how to secure your place will be announced by the club.
